requirement: v3.7.2 gate: prove the desktop remote-view default on three physical machines - six directed viewer/target legs build over the shared WebRTC pool, return WebRTC/encrypted/relay_used=false with REMOTE_ACK_OK, and deliver a first JPEG frame in every direction.
notes: Six directed legs were run directly through /api/w2m/remote/start and /frame, not as relay tasks; task_id labels the acceptance run. Mac-to-IM2A and Mac-to-ToFuture required the public TURN at 43.142.74.71:3479 for ICE; relay_used=false proves the W2M encrypted relay was not involved, not that TURN was absent. ToFuture target used the stable 8790 signal; the Mac target required disabling the standalone localside launchd consumer so the DSH host was the sole WebRTC pool owner. The IM2A viewer used a 25 s profile prepareTimeoutMs override because its cold target pool took about 20 s. Thirty-minute soak and TURN outage fallback were not run in the v3.7.2 window.
